[[File:Mark_II_medium_repeater.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Mark II medium repeating blaster cannon]]]]
'''Repeating blaster cannons''' were heavy [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] that could lay down sustained, rapid fire. They were effective for scything down waves of advancing [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]], and some models had the capability to fire high intensity blasts which could destroy light vehicles. Certain repeating blaster cannons also had the capability to fire slower, high intensity blasts. Repeating blaster cannons were built into the arms of the [[Droideka/Legends|Droideka]], the [[E4 baron droid]], and the [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]].
